experiment: Qwen3-8B BPF RLVR Phase 2 Controlled Generalization Pilot

selected_checkpoint.selection_criterion: Best Dev Functional Pass@1 (23/48, +1 task net gain, tie-breaker: earlier step over step 20)

early_stopping.reason: 3 consecutive evaluations without Dev functional improvement (Step 15: 22/48, Step 20: 23/48, Step 25: 22/48)

promotion_decision.rationale: Dev selection gate (+1/48 vs +3/48 required) and Locked Confirmation gate (+2/60 vs +3/60 required) did not meet normative promotion thresholds. SFT v2 retained as default.

operational_vps_execution_100pct.required: 100% of candidate code executed empirically on Linux VPS kernel

operational_fail_closed_infrastructure.required: 0 infrastructure errors converted to numeric rewards

operational_contamination_audit.required: 100% semantic disjointness across all splits and protected benchmarks

efficacy_dev_selection_ge_3.required: At least +3/48 tasks over SFT v2 baseline (>= 25/48)

efficacy_locked_confirmation_ge_3.required: At least +3/60 tasks over SFT v2 baseline (>= +5.0%, >= 36/60)

efficacy_confirmation_paired_direction.required: Fail->pass recoveries must exceed pass->fail regressions

efficacy_protected_synthesis_exceeds_sft.required: Must exceed SFT v2 baseline (> 31/120, i.e. >= 32/120)

efficacy_zero_concentrated_regressions.required: No category or difficulty stratum may lose > 2 tasks
efficacy_zero_concentrated_regressions.observed: Max category loss is 2 (protocol_transformation: 1 cal, 1 rep); 0 strata lost > 2 tasks
